applyTo: "apps/**/*.js,apps/**/*.jsx,packages/ui/**/*.js,packages/ui/**/*.jsx"

# Frontend Guidelines

- Follow existing Next.js and shared UI patterns before adding new abstractions.
- Handle loading, empty, error, validation, and responsive states for every user-facing workflow.
- Keep private complaint details out of public issue intelligence views.
- Label synthetic or demo data clearly and use allegation-safe regulatory language.
- Keep business logic in backend services and use accessible controls with keyboard support.
- Add focused user-flow or component tests for critical complaint and tracking behavior.
